# Steelers select Layne in third round

#  Steelers select Layne in third round  
Apr 26, 2019 at 10:34 PM  
*   *   *   * Copied!  
**Justin Layne
Cornerback
Michigan State
6-2, 192
Cleveland, Ohio
Benedictine High School
3rd Round â 83rd Overall**  
**CAREER NOTES**
Three-year letterwinner, playing in 34 games (26 starts) at cornerback for Michigan Stateâ¦recorded 130 career tackles, including 4.5 tackles for loss and a half-sackâ¦added 24 career passes defensed and three interceptionsâ¦began his Spartans' career as a wide receiver before transitioning to cornerback midway through his 2016 season.  
**2018 SEASON**

# Steelers select Layne in third round

**2018 SEASON**
Second-Team All-Big Ten selectionâ¦recipient of Spartans' most outstanding underclass back award on defenseâ¦recorded a career-high 15 pass breakups, tied as the eighth-most in a single-season in school historyâ¦finished fifth on the defense with a career-best 72 tackles, including 2.5 for lossâ¦ led the Spartans with nine tackles against Central Michigan (Sept. 29), adding an interceptionâ¦tied for the team-high with eight tackles against Northwestern (Oct. 6)â¦broke up four passes, a career-high, along with seven tackles vs. Purdue (Oct. 27)â¦matched a career-high 10 tackles against Ohio State (Nov. 10), adding 1.5 tackles for loss and a half-sackâ¦ tallied six tackles and two passes defensed vs. Rutgers (Nov. 24).  
**2017 SEASON**

# Steelers select Layne in third round

**2017 SEASON**
Earned honorable mention All-Big Ten accoladesâ¦recorded 40 tackles in 13 games with nine startsâ¦ranked second on the defense with eight passes defensedâ¦posted five tackles and the first forced fumble of his career against No. 7 Michigan (Oct. 7)â¦posted a career-best 10 tackles vs. Indiana (Oct. 21)â¦had two tackles and two pass breakups in win vs. No. 7 Penn State (Nov. 4)â¦hauled in an interception in the end zone vs. No. 11 Ohio State (Nov. 11), adding three tackles and two passes defensedâ¦amassed five tackles and a career-high three passes defensed vs. Maryland (Nov. 18).  
**2016 SEASON**
Saw action in nine games, one at wide receiver and eight at cornerback, starting five of the last seven contestsâ¦totaled 18 tackles, 1.5 tackles for loss and an interceptionâ¦made first career start vs. Northwestern (Oct. 15), hauling in an interception and returned it 43 yards for a touchdownâ¦had a season-high four tackles at Maryland (Oct. 22).  
**HIGH SCHOOL**

# Steelers select Layne in third round

**HIGH SCHOOL**
A three-year starter at Benedictine (Cleveland, Ohio) High Schoolâ¦logged a career-high 46 catches for 790 yards (17.2 average) and 11 touchdowns in 2015, adding three punt returns for touchdownsâ¦set a school single-game record with 12 catches for 187 yards and two touchdowns in a regional finalâ¦caught 36 passes for 866 yards and 12 touchdowns as a seniorâ¦hauled in seven interceptions in 2014â¦also a four-year letterman in basketball, and track and field.
